title: Promo completion loses a concurrently added item
description: An item added while promo validation is pending disappears when validation completes.

steps: Apply the promo and immediately add Mouse Pad
report.expected: Keyboard and Mouse Pad should both remain after the promo is applied.
report.actual: Mouse Pad disappears when the promo result arrives.
report.context: Fresh browser storage; promo validation is asynchronous.

preconditions: Promo validation is pending (e.g., a promo code has been entered but not yet validated).
steps: 1. Add an item to the cart while the promo validation is pending.
2. Wait for the promo validation to complete.
reproduction.expected: The item should remain in the cart after promo validation completes.
reproduction.actual: The item disappears from the cart after promo validation completes.
